options: As a rule, single sentences shall not have written or printed as paragraphs.

solution:

☛ Parallel structure is maintained with "written" and "printed" both as past participles.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Passive Voice: Subject + modal (should/can/must) + be + V3 + by + agent.
☛ Past Participle: Memorize irregular verbs like write-wrote-written, print-printed-printed.
☛ Modals: After shall/will/should/might, use base verb (V1) or "be" + V3.

Example:
Incorrect - The report might be submit late.
Correct - The report might be submitted late.
